apps.localizedDescription:
Ūrjas is a personal, rebranded fork of NOOP (github.com/ryanbr/noop) by @ryanbr, with a refreshed UI and two net-new analytics on top of NOOP's full feature set:

• Personal Training Zones (DFA-α1) — reads the fractal correlation of your beat-to-beat heartbeat during a workout and maps it to Easy / Moderate / Hard intensity, using the published α1≈0.75 (aerobic) and α1≈0.50 (anaerobic) thresholds. No lab test or measured max-HR needed.

• Overnight Breathing — a relative blood-oxygen steadiness screen for each night, banded Steady / Some Variability / Frequent Dips. This is a wellness trend, NOT a medical test or an apnea diagnosis; if you have symptoms, see a doctor.

Unsigned build — AltStore re-signs it on-device with your free Apple ID. All credit for the underlying app goes to @ryanbr and the NOOP project.
